posts.zh:
dsh-archive-manager 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH Web UI 的归档会话管理器：重新打开已归档会话并继续对话、取消归档恢复原位、彻底删除会话，支持分组浏览、消息搜索与原生视图同步。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-288526262e9ca2b267e4.html
posts.en:
dsh-archive-manager is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Archived-session manager for DSH Web UI: reopen an archived session and keep chatting, unarchive it back in place, or hard-delete a session — grouped panel with message search and native view sync.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-288526262e9ca2b267e4.html
